camel_example: aliyun csas CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --MatchMode UserGroupNormal --MidRiskOperation Notify --ScanMode Quick --ScanEndTime 6 --PerformanceMode Balance --ScanTargets.1 Virus --StrategyName '研发部门每周扫描' --ScanFrequency week --HighRiskOperation Quarantine --ScanInterval 1 --ScanBeginTime 1 --LowRiskOperation None --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a scheduled virus scan policy that automatically sends scan tasks to user terminal devices within the effective scope based on the configured cycle
description_zh: 创建一条病毒定时扫描策略，按配置的周期自动向生效范围内的用户终端设备下发扫描任务
kebab_example: aliyun csas create-virus-scan-scheduled-strategy --strategy-name '研发部门每周扫描' --status Enabled --scan-targets Virus --scan-mode Quick --performance-mode Balance --high-risk-operation Quarantine --mid-risk-operation Notify --low-risk-operation None --match-mode UserGroupNormal --scan-frequency week --scan-interval 1 --scan-begin-time 1 --scan-end-time 6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy

parameters.help_en: The policy name. The name can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、连字符（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端全盘扫描
parameters.help_en: The policy description. The description can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 策略描述。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及空格、半角句点（.）、逗号（,）、分号（;）、正斜杠（/）、@、连字符（-）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: strategy_description

parameters.help_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled.

After the policy is enabled, it immediately participates in periodic scheduling. When the policy is disabled, it is only saved and does not trigger scans
parameters.help_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用。
启用后策略立即参与周期调度；停用时策略仅保存，不触发扫描
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus types to be handled in this scan. At least one type must be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 本次扫描要处置的病毒类型集合，至少包含1个，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_targets

parameters.help_en:
The path scope of the scan. Valid values:
Quick: quick scan. Only system critical directories and common risk locations are scanned.
Full: full disk scan.
Custom: custom path scan. ScanPath is required when this value is specified
parameters.help_zh:
扫描的路径范围。取值：
Quick：快速扫描，仅扫描系统关键目录与常见风险位置。
Full：全盘扫描。
Custom：自定义路径扫描，此时ScanPath必填
parameters.name: scan_mode

parameters.help_en: The collection of custom scan paths. This parameter is required when ScanMode is set to Custom and cannot be specified when ScanMode is set to Quick or Full. A maximum of 100 paths can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 自定义扫描路径集合。ScanMode取值为Custom时必填，取值为Quick或Full时不允许传入。最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_path

parameters.help_en:
The scan performance mode. Valid values:
SecurityFirst: security first. The default CPU usage limit is 50%.
Balance: balanced. The default CPU usage limit is 30%.
ExperienceFirst: experience first. The default CPU usage limit is 15%
parameters.help_zh:
扫描性能模式。取值：
SecurityFirst：安全优先，CPU占用上限默认为50%。
Balance：均衡，CPU占用上限默认为30%。
ExperienceFirst：体验优先，CPU占用上限默认为15%
parameters.name: performance_mode

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
parameters.help_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件
parameters.name: high_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
parameters.help_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件
parameters.name: mid_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
None: take no action
parameters.help_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理
parameters.name: low_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The matching method for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: the policy takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: the policy takes effect only for users in specified user groups. UserGroupIds is required when this value is specified
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效，此时UserGroupIds必填
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The list of exempt users. Users in this list are excluded from the scan triggered by this policy. A maximum of 1000 users can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。最多包含1000个，不允许重复
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The collection of user group IDs for the effective scope. This parameter is required when MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal and cannot be specified when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll. At least 1 and at most 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupNormal时必填，取值为UserGroupAll时不允许传入。传入时至少包含1个，最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: by day.
week: by week
parameters.help_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周
parameters.name: scan_frequency

parameters.help_en: The interval number of the trigger cycle. This parameter works together with ScanFrequency to determine the trigger cycle. Valid values: 1 to 30. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week
parameters.help_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。取值范围：1~30。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次
parameters.name: scan_interval

parameters.help_en: The start hour for triggering scans, specified as a whole hour. Valid values: 0 to 23 (inclusive). This field is not a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳
parameters.name: scan_begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end hour for triggering scans, specified as a whole hour. Valid values: 1 to 24 (exclusive of the specified hour). The value must be greater than ScanBeginTime. Scan tasks generated by each trigger expire at this hour on the same day. This field is not a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。每次触发生成的扫描任务在当天该整点失效。本字段不是时间戳
parameters.name: scan_end_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum percentage of terminal CPU usage during scanning. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the default value based on PerformanceMode is used: 50 for SecurityFirst, 30 for Balance, and 15 for ExperienceFirst
parameters.help_zh: 扫描时占用终端CPU的百分比上限。取值范围：0~100。不传或传0时，按PerformanceMode取默认值：SecurityFirst为50，Balance为30，ExperienceFirst为15
parameters.name: max_cpu_usage

StrategyId.description_en: The ID of the created scheduled virus scan policy
StrategyId.description_zh: 创建的病毒定时扫描策略ID
